valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E comparable diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date, converted from EUR to USD at the 2026-11-13 ECB reference rate of 1.1052 EUR/USD).

bear.driver: European volume softness, input cost inflation, and multiple compression

base.driver: 3-4% FX-neutral revenue growth, ~7% operating profit growth, and ongoing buybacks

bull.driver: Stronger APS/energy drink mix, margin expansion, and multiple re-rating

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $5.36 (€4.85), the $118.57 close implies 22.1x P/E; the Street consensus target range ($111-$114) implies 20.7x-21.3x P/E.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $5.36 (4.5 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Comparable FX-neutral revenue growth (3-4% FY2026 guidance) and operating profit growth (~7% FY2026 guidance)

analyst_notes: Following CCEP's Q3 2026 trading update on November 3, 2026 (revenue +5.8% comparable FX-neutral, full-year guidance reaffirmed), Barclays raised its target from $124 to $130 (Overweight) and Wells Fargo ($120, Overweight) and Deutsche Bank ($116, Buy) maintained constructive stances, while JPMorgan remains Underweight at $92. Overall Street targets cluster around $111-$114, slightly below the $118.57 close, indicating limited near-term multiple expansion unless FY2027 earnings growth exceeds the ~7% operating profit trajectory.
